name: mapprefs-jasshelper
description: war3mapExtra.txt (branch map-settings-we): Studio ticks Map Properties > Preferences > Enable JassHelper; the World Editor opens Studio's save and saves it again: the same bytes (it read the switch: its file is written from what it holds, an empty file with JassHelper off)

steps.eval: window.__prefs = async (actions) => { const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await w3.commands.execute('w3.mapInfo.open', 'preferences'); const body = async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.map-info .form-body')].find((x) => x.querySelector('h2')?.textContent === 'Preferences'); if (b) return b; await wait(100); } throw new Error('Map Properties > Preferences did not open'); }; for (const [kind, label, value] of actions) { if (kind === 'check') { const l = [...(await body()).querySelectorAll('label.form-check')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === label); if (!l) throw new Error('no box ' + label); const box = l.querySelector('input'); if (box.disabled) throw new Error(label + ' is greyed'); if (box.checked !== value) box.click(); } else { let sel = null; for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !sel; i++) { const r = [...(await body()).querySelectorAll('label.form-row')].find((x) => x.querySelector('.form-label')?.textContent === label); const s = r?.querySelector('select'); if (s && [...s.options].some((o) => o.value === String(value))) sel = s; else await wait(100); } if (!sel) throw new Error('no choice ' + value + ' in ' + label); sel.value = String(value); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); } await wait(300); } }; await window.__prefs([['check', 'Enable JassHelper', true]]);
